jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Be the true you**
-------------------



Build robust software solutions. Join our innovation team developing and implementing technical solutions that solve real business challenges. Design, build, and scale software that directly impacts how our organization works. At Deloitte.


**Benefits**
------------


* You’ll receive a profit\-sharing bonus, on top of your fixed salary.
* Continuous professional growth. Join our development program.
* A work\-from\-home office setup allowance to make sure you have everything you need for an ergonomically designed workstation and internet allowance.
* Work part\-time (32 hours a week) or full\-time (40 hours a week).
* Flexible and hybrid working, in accordance with team and client commitments.
* 26 days of paid annual leave, and the opportunity to purchase additional leave.
* A good mobility scheme: the choice of various options such as a lease car, travel by public transport, a cash option or a combination of these.
* A laptop and iPhone. The iPhone can also be used for personal purposes.
* A time for time arrangement that creates flexibility for personal moments that matter.
* A good pension scheme with a personal contribution of only 2%.
* An opportunity to take part in our collective health insurance scheme.
* An opportunity to benefit from tax\-efficient facilities such as company fitness, a bicycle scheme or the opportunity to lease a bicycle.
* The opportunity to use 55 hours of babysitting service per calendar year if your child is 12 years old or younger.
* A flexible budget, which you can use to make choices in flexible benefits, for example purchasing extra leave days or financing a bicycle plan.
* Various leave options tailored to meet your individual needs, from parental leave (also for rainbow families) to the flexibility of exchanging three national holidays for non\-national holidays.

**Be the true you**
-------------------



We have a dynamic way of working, which means not all our solutions work with the same stack. One day you’re building the newest prototype we’d like to develop for our Audit department, the next day one of our battle\-tested solutions requires its monthly software update. Your mental context window allows you to do both in the same week, in addition to this expectation, we are looking for someone that identifies with the following profile:

* Has a few years of experience with developing production\-grade software using C\#, Java, Python or TypeScript and is well\-versed in architectures that are usually occurring in those languages.
* Previously has worked with technology that enables those products, think of AWS, GCP or Azure
* Experience packaging and running applications in containers, using Docker and an orchestrator such as Kubernetes.
* Have collaborated with other developers via Git, using a platform like GitHub or Azure DevOps
* Able to communicate about their work, both the outcome and process, estimations and possible issues


**What impact will you make?**
------------------------------



Team Tomorrow is a team of \~90 employees with a very wide array of skills. We’re innovating how Deloitte works by optimizing internal processes, implementing novel technical solutions, and generally elevating how our colleague’s work. As a Software Engineer, you’re part of our group of Builders. We are responsible for delivering technical solutions, developing rapid prototype(s) and serving as experts for our colleagues that are not involved in the technical part of these solutions.


**How do you do this?**
-----------------------



As a Software Engineer, you will be actively involved in the development of our solutions in collaboration with designers, product owners and other engineers, as well as stakeholders in the business. You have a curious mind, in the age of AI simply writing code doesn’t just do it for you. You want to understand how and why code works and why some solutions are used within a specific context. You have an eye for detail and take a proactive approach when creating new features and/or solutions. Your expertise is valued within all steps of the process from idea to product.


In addition to creating, you also value growth and learning for yourself and your colleagues. We invite you to learn from us and have us learn things from you. This can be about a niche subject you’re captivated by or the newest version of a front\-end framework.


Beyond that, we value ownership and eminence. We don’t expect you to understand and/or master everything when you join, but we expect you to continuously learn and grow in this matter. Your basics are strong and from there, you’re open to exploring more advanced and complex patterns. AI serves as your accelerator, not as your substitution. Among all the points mentioned above, we have some indicators whether you could be suited for this role:

* You have a foundational knowledge of a language like C\#, Java, Python or similar and have worked with this in a production environment for a few years.
* In addition, you’ve embedded frameworks or plugins using package managers and are familiar with the ecosystems that surround the mentioned languages above.
* Collaboration is key, which means that you are suited to work with Git and can share your work on GitHub or a similar environment. This also means you’re able to explain your code in writing and speech.
* You are a curious, creative, and social person. We don’t expect you to immediately stand in front of all of us to present, but you are communicative by nature, are okay to challenge people on their ideas and not afraid to receive constructive feedback.
* Our core business is innovation, so keeping up with trends and/or taking an active role in learning new things is expected.

**Questions or doubts? Get in touch.**
--------------------------------------


Marit Oudman (Recruiter)

jobs.title: Product Developer Stagiar(e)
jobs.description:
Wij zijn op zoek naar een enthousiaste Product Developer Stagiair(e) met een leergierige en actieve houding



**Enthousiaste Product Developer Stagiair(e) gezocht!**
-------------------------------------------------------


**Standplaats:** Apeldoorn (deels hybride)
  

**Uren:** 39 uur per week (fulltime)
  

**Start:** zo snel mogelijk


**Wil jij niet alleen leren hoe software wordt ontwikkeld, maar er ook écht aan meebouwen?**
  

Bij Paragon krijg je als stagiair Product Developer de kans om ervaring op te doen met echte softwareproducten, moderne Microsoft\-technologie en een professioneel developmentteam. Je draait mee met ervaren developers én krijgt ruimte voor een eigen stageproject dat aansluit bij jouw interesses en leerdoelen.


### **Jouw stage bij Paragon**


Als **Product Developer stagiair** maak je kennis met het volledige softwareontwikkelproces. Van het eerste idee en het vertalen van wensen naar requirements, tot ontwikkelen, testen en uiteindelijk het uitrollen van software die dagelijks door klanten wordt gebruikt.
  

  

Ongeveer **70% van je tijd werk je mee in het Business ICT\-team**. Je leert van ervaren collega's, pakt echte werkzaamheden op en ontdekt hoe het er in een professionele Agile\-omgeving aan toegaat.
  

  

De overige **30% besteed je aan je eigen stageproject**. Samen met je begeleider kies je een concreet project dat past bij jouw opleiding, interesses en leerdoelen. Zo combineer je praktijkervaring met een eigen resultaat waar je aan het einde van je stage met trots op kunt terugkijken.


### **Wat ga je doen?**


Tijdens je stage krijg je de mogelijkheid om mee te werken aan verschillende onderdelen van softwareontwikkeling. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan:


* Ontwerpen, bouwen en testen van softwareapplicaties met C\#/.NET
* Werken met Microsoft Azure en Azure Functions
* Meewerken volgens Agile en deelnemen aan sprintplanningen en stand\-ups
* Leren hoe ideeën en klantwensen worden vertaald naar concrete requirements en developmenttaken
* Samenwerken met developers, testers en collega's uit andere disciplines
* Aanschuiven bij code reviews en leren hoe je feedback geeft én ontvangt
* Meedenken over technische documentatie en softwarekwaliteit
* Nieuwe technologieën en ontwikkelingen volgen en jouw kennis delen met het team

Je krijgt daarbij volop ruimte om vragen te stellen, nieuwe dingen uit te proberen en stap voor stap zelfstandiger te worden.


### **Jouw eigen stageproject**


Naast het meewerken in het team werk je aan een eigen, afgebakend project. We kijken samen welk onderwerp het beste bij jou past. Een aantal voorbeelden:


* **End\-to\-end testautomatisering met Playwright**
  

Onderzoek hoe onze applicaties momenteel worden getest en ontdek hoe testautomatisering kan bijdragen aan de kwaliteit van onze software. Je zet een Playwright\-testframework op, implementeert geautomatiseerde regressietests en levert documentatie en advies op voor toekomstig gebruik.
* **AI\-assisted development**
  

AI verandert de manier waarop software wordt ontwikkeld. Jij onderzoekt hoe AI\-tools binnen development kunnen worden ingezet, welke kansen en aandachtspunten er zijn en hoe we hier binnen Paragon op een goede manier mee kunnen omgaan. Je werkt richtlijnen, voorbeelden en best practices uit en presenteert je bevindingen aan het team.
* **Security en penetratesten**
  

Duik in de wereld van applicatiebeveiliging. Je ondersteunt bij beveiligingstesten, analyseert bevindingen en denkt mee over verbetermaatregelen waarmee de veiligheid van onze applicaties verder kan worden versterkt.
* **Heb je zelf een interessant idee voor een stageproject?**
  

Ook daar staan we voor open. Als jouw idee aansluit bij Business ICT, gaan we graag samen met jou kijken naar de mogelijkheden.

### **Wat ga je leren?**


Deze stage geeft je een kijkje in de volledige softwareontwikkelcyclus. Je leert onder andere:


* Hoe software wordt ontwikkeld binnen een professionele Agile\-organisatie
* Hoe een idee wordt vertaald naar requirements, ontwikkeling, testen en productie
* Werken met moderne technologieën zoals C\#/.NET en Azure
* Samenwerken binnen een multidisciplinair team
* Werken met code reviews en testautomatisering
* Hoe je softwarekwaliteit en security meeneemt in je werk
* Hoe IT en business samenkomen binnen een organisatie

### **Dit ben jij?**


Je bent een nieuwsgierige HBO\-ICT\-student die graag wil ontdekken hoe het er in de praktijk écht aan toegaat. Je hoeft nog geen expert te zijn. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je wilt leren en initiatief durft te nemen. Verder:


* Volg je een **HBO\-opleiding in de richting ICT of Software Engineering**, bijvoorbeeld HBO\-ICT of Technische Informatica
* Zit je in een fase van je opleiding waarin een stage past
* Heb je basiskennis van softwareontwikkeling en bij voorkeur C\#/.NET
* Heb je interesse in cloudtechnologie en bij voorkeur al enige kennis van Azure
* Communiceer je duidelijk, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk
* Ben je leergierig, nieuwsgierig en proactief
* Kun je zelfstandig werken, maar weet je ook wanneer je hulp of feedback moet vragen
* Werk je graag samen met anderen

### **Wat mag je van ons verwachten?**


Bij Paragon krijg je meer dan alleen een plek om je stage\-uren te maken. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en praktijkervaring op te doen binnen een ervaren Business ICT\-team. Je kunt rekenen op:


* Een leerzame stage van 4 maanden of iets langer
* Persoonlijke begeleiding door een vaste, ervaren Product Developer
* Praktijkervaring met C\#/.NET en Azure
* De mogelijkheid om je te verdiepen in onder andere testautomatisering, AI\-assisted development of security
* Een eigen stageproject met een concreet en toetsbaar eindresultaat
* Een marktconforme stagevergoeding
* Een laptop die je tijdens je stage kunt gebruiken
* Een informele en open werksfeer waarin je wordt aangemoedigd om vragen te stellen, ideeën te delen en te groeien
* Mogelijkheid tot deels thuiswerken, in overleg
* En wie weet: bevalt het van beide kanten goed en is er na je studie een passende vacature? Dan kijken we graag samen naar de mogelijkheden om bij Paragon te blijven werken.

### **Praktische informatie**


**Duur:** \+/\- 4 maanden, of afgestemd op jouw studieprogramma
  

**Omvang:** bij voorkeur 32\-40 uur per week, in overleg
  

**Standplaats:** Apeldoorn, met mogelijkheid tot deels thuiswerken in overleg
  

**Begeleiding:** wekelijkse begeleiding, tussentijdse evaluaties en een eindevaluatie
  

**Voorzieningen:** je krijgt een laptop ter beschikking tijdens je stage


### **Over Paragon**


Paragon maakt deel uit van een wereldwijd opererende organisatie die bedrijven ondersteunt bij het optimaliseren van hun klantcommunicatie en interactie. Paragon groeit organisch en we faciliteren klantcommunicatie voor vooraanstaande (internationale) organisaties. We hebben grote ambities om verder te groeien. Wil jij bijdragen aan de uitbreiding van ons succes?


### **Enthousiast geworden? We maken graag kennis met jou!**


**Stuur snel je cv, een korte motivatie en je stageopdracht of leerbehoefte naar** **hrm@paragon\-cc.nl**


**Vertel ons vooral waar jij enthousiast van wordt en wat je tijdens je stage wilt leren. Wie weet verwelkomen we jou binnenkort als onze nieuwe Product Developer stagiair!**


**Vragen over de stage? Bel gerust met Nick Massa, Technology Director: 06\-10013100\.**

jobs.description:
**Be the true you**
-------------------



Bouw robuuste softwareoplossingen. Versterk ons innovatieteam en help technische oplossingen ontwikkelen en implementeren om echte bedrijfsuitdagingen op te lossen. Ontwerp, bouw en schaal software die direct impact heeft op hoe onze organisatie werkt. Bij Deloitte.


**Benefits**
------------


* Je deelt bij ons mee in de winst, boven op een vast salaris.
* Altijd blijven groeien met ons development program.
* Flexibele werktijden en hybride werken, afgestemd op je team en je klantverplichtingen.
* 26 vakantiedagen per jaar bij een fulltime dienstverband en de mogelijkheid om extra dagen in te kopen.
* Parttime (32 uur) of fulltime (40 uur) werken.
* Ruil 3 nationale feestdagen voor 3 niet\-nationale feestdagen, als je wilt.
* Een tijd\-voor\-tijdregeling. Gebruik de tijd die je op het ene moment meer maakt op momenten die er voor jou toe doen.
* De mogelijkheid om minimaal 2 maanden op sabbatical te gaan.
* Een goede mobiliteitsregeling: de keuze uit verschillende opties zoals een leaseauto, reizen met het OV, een cash budget of een combinatie daarvan.
* Vergoeding om je thuiswerkplek op een ergonomisch verantwoorde manier in te richten én een internetvergoeding.
* De mogelijkheid om gebruik te maken van 55 uur oppasdienst per kalenderjaar, als jouw kind 12 jaar of jonger is.
* Een laptop en iPhone. De iPhone mag je ook privé gebruiken.
* Een pensioenregeling waarbij je eigen bijdrage slechts 2% is.
* Mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan de collectieve zorgkostenregeling.
* Fiscaal voordelige regelingen, zoals bedrijfsfitness, het aanschaffen van een fiets tegen bruto salaris of de mogelijkheid om een fiets te leasen.
* Een maandelijks budget waarmee je keuzes kunt maken in flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals extra vakantiedagen of het financieren van een fietsplan.
* Zes weken volledig betaald geboorteverlof voor traditionele huishoudens en regenbooggezinnen.

**Be the true you**
-------------------



Wij werken in een dynamische omgeving, wat betekent dat niet al onze oplossingen op dezelfde stack draaien. De ene dag bouw je het nieuwste prototype dat we voor onze Audit\-afdeling willen ontwikkelen, de volgende dag vraagt een van onze beproefde oplossingen om zijn maandelijkse software\-update. Jouw mentale context window is groot genoeg om beide in dezelfde week te doen. Herken je jezelf in dat profiel, en zijn de volgende punten van toepassing? Dan hebben we waarschijnlijk een match

* Je hebt een aantal jaren ervaring met het ontwikkelen van production\-grade software in C\#, Java, Python of TypeScript en bent goed thuis in de architecturen die je doorgaans bij die talen tegenkomt.
* Je hebt eerder gewerkt met de technologie die deze producten mogelijk maakt, denk aan AWS, GCP of Azure.
* Je hebt ervaring met het packagen en draaien van applicaties in containers, met Docker en een orchestrator als Kubernetes.
* Je hebt samengewerkt met andere developers via Git, op een platform als GitHub of Azure DevOps.
* Je kunt communiceren over je werk: zowel het resultaat als het proces, inschattingen en mogelijke knelpunten.


**What impact will you make?**
------------------------------



Team Tomorrow is een team van zo'n 90 collega’s met een breed palet aan skills. Wij vernieuwen de manier waarop Deloitte werkt door interne processen te optimaliseren, innovatieve technische oplossingen te implementeren en in bredere zin de manier waarop onze collega's werken naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Als Software Engineer maak je deel uit van onze groep Builders. Wij zijn verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van technische oplossingen, het ontwikkelen van snelle prototypes en het als technisch aanspreekpunt fungeren voor collega's die niet bij dat deel van deze oplossingen betrokken zijn.


**How do you do this?**
-----------------------



Als Software Engineer ben je actief betrokken bij de ontwikkeling van onze oplossingen, in samenwerking met designers, product owners en andere engineers, én met stakeholders binnen de business. Je bent nieuwsgierig van aard; in het AI\-tijdperk is alleen code schrijven voor jou niet genoeg. Je wilt begrijpen hoe en waarom code werkt, en waarom bepaalde oplossingen binnen een specifieke context worden gekozen. Je hebt oog voor detail en pakt proactief door bij het bouwen van nieuwe features en/of oplossingen. Jouw expertise is waardevol in alle stappen van het proces, van idee tot product.


Naast bouwen hecht je ook waarde aan groei en leren, voor jezelf en voor je collega's. We nodigen je uit om van ons te leren en ons van jou te laten leren. Dat kan gaan over een niche\-onderwerp waar jij door gegrepen bent of over de nieuwste versie van een front\-end framework.


Daarnaast vinden wij eigenaar\- en vakmanschap belangrijk. We verwachten niet dat je bij binnenkomst alles begrijpt en/of beheerst, maar wel dat je jezelf hierin blijft ontwikkelen. Je hebt een stevige basis en bouwt van daaruit graag verder richting complexere vraagstukken en oplossingen. AI is je versneller, niet je vervanger. Naast alle bovengenoemde punten hebben we een aantal indicatoren of deze rol bij je past:

* Je hebt een gedegen basiskennis van een taal als C\#, Java, Python of een vergelijkbare taal en hebt daar een aantal jaren mee gewerkt in een productieomgeving.
* Daarnaast heb je frameworks of plugins geïntegreerd met behulp van package managers en ben je bekend met de ecosystemen rondom de hierboven genoemde talen.
* Samenwerken staat centraal: je bent gewend om met Git te werken en kunt je werk delen via GitHub of een vergelijkbare omgeving. Dat betekent ook dat je je code goed kunt toelichten, zowel schriftelijk als mondeling.
* Je bent nieuwsgierig, creatief en sociaal. We verwachten niet dat je meteen voor de hele groep staat te presenteren, maar je bent communicatief van aard, durft anderen op hun ideeën te bevragen en staat open voor constructieve feedback.
* Innovatie is onze core business, dus we verwachten dat je trends volgt en/of actief nieuwe dingen leert.


**Vragen of twijfels? Neem contact op.**
----------------------------------------


Marit Oudman (Recruiter)

jobs.title: Vacature: Senior Azure/DataBricks Data engineer (Freelance) - View vacancy
jobs.description:
NN is in beweging om een data gedreven organisatie te worden. Als Azure/DataBricks Data engineer gebruik jij je kennis en ervaring met de nieuwste data technologieën om van data informatie te maken.

  

  

Je hebt ruime ervaring met data\- en software engineering best practices en ontwikkelt schaalbare, robuuste en herbruikbare oplossingen die op enterprise schaal door meerdere teams worden toegepast. Je bent in staat om zelfstandig te werken, neemt eigenaarschap over je oplossingen en weet effectief om te gaan met een complex stakeholderlandschap binnen een platformomgeving met veel teams. Je weet mensen mee te nemen in je oplossingen, kunt complexe technische concepten begrijpelijk uitleggen en bent didactisch sterk in het begeleiden van teams.

  

  

Samen met je collega engineers bouw jij elke dag nieuwe functionaliteiten om onze klanten optimaal te kunnen bedienen.

  

  

Jouw impact als data engineer bij NN


Het Life \& Pensions Data Analytics Platform (LPDAP) is het centrale data¬platform waarop data voor het volledige Life \& Pensions domein wordt ingenomen, verrijkt en ontsloten om herbruikbare dataproducten te bouwen voor interne en externe afnemers.

  

  

Het LPDAP kent een ambitieuze roadmap voor 2026 voor verbetering en uitbreiding. Daarvoor is het LEAP programma opgezet en zetten wij de nieuwste technologie van Microsoft in, zoals Azure Data Factory en Azure Databricks. Verder ga je veel werken met Azure DevOps en Git. Programmeren ga je vooral doen in Python, SQL en PySpark.

  

  

Samen met je collega’s bouw jij aan best practices en generieke data capabilities voor data pipelines, die door meerdere DevOps teams gebruikt kunnen worden. Denk hierbij standaarden/richtlijnen en aan herbruikbare capabilities, zoals data quality, orchestratie, logging/monitoring. Je gaat voor herbruikbaarheid, kwaliteit, en neemt vanzelfsprekend non\-functional requirements hierin mee.

  

  

Databricks en Azure zijn hierbij je grootste vriend. Je werkt daarvoor nauw samen met de vele data engineers, die aan data pipelines werken. Je wordt in dit proces ook ondersteund door onze cloud engineers, die zorgen dat jij je werk zo efficiënt mogelijk kan doen. Je denkt mee met je collega’s hoe de DevOps teams zo goed mogelijk met de capabilties worden bediend en hoe de gebruikers de data zo simpel mogelijk uit het platform kunnen halen. Zo maak je het werk voor iedereen een stuk makkelijker.

  

  

**Wat je gaat doen**


* Continue implementatie en verbetering van (nieuwe) generieke, herbuikbare capabilities voor data pipelines, te gebruiken door de DevOps teams
* Samenwerken met collega data engineers en platform engineers voor integreren van de capabilities op ons data platform
  

  

**Wat wij jou bieden**


Onze mensen zijn de drijvende kracht van de organisatie. Dat geldt niet alleen voor onze interne medewerkers, maar ook voor onze interim professionals. De specialistische kennis en ervaring die jij in huis hebt, is voor ons van grote waarde. Wij bieden jou:


* Marktconform uurtarief afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring
* Begindatum 1 oktober, met een duur van 6 maanden
* Hybride werken, deels vanuit huis en deels op kantoor
* Internationale werkomgeving met veel kennisdeling
  

  

**Wat je meebrengt**


Jouw analytische brein en assertieve “can do” mentaliteit komt hier volledig tot zijn recht: je mag je tanden zetten in ambitieuze uitdagingen, waar je samen met je collega’s hard aan werkt om tijdig te kunnen leveren conform de afgesproken requirements en tijdslijnen. Je schuwt geen vraag om inzicht te krijgen in wat er speelt en duikt met een kritische blik het platform in. Ondertussen volg je alle ontwikkelingen in infrastructuur en andere delen van je vakgebied. Verder heb je:


* Een flinke dosis kennis van Azure. Azure en Databricks certificering zijn een grote pré
* Ervaring met programmeren in Python, PySpark en SQL
* Ervaring met Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure DevOps, CI/CD en software engineering
* Ervaring met of kennis van data engineering tools en best practices
* Een “can do” en “automation\-first” mentaliteit en je moet in staat zijn om binnen korte (inwerk)tijd mee te draaien in het team
* Minimaal B1 niveau Engels, vloeiend Nederlands is een pré
* Je hebt passie voor IT en Data en ervaring met Agile werken
  

  

**Met wie je werkt**


Je komt in een Enablement team met collega data engineers, allen met hun eigen specialiteiten. Je werkt daarbij op één (LPDAP) platform nauw samen met meerdere DevOps teams en stakeholders binnen het Life \& Pensions domein, waarbij afstemming en heldere communicatie essentieel zijn.

  

  

Jij brengt veel ervaring met en kennis van Databricks en Azure met je mee zodat het team de ambities en doelstelling van het Life\&Pensions Data Analytics Platform kan waarmaken. We blijven onszelf altijd verbeteren en halen graag het beste in elkaar naar boven. Om dat te doen praten we écht met elkaar zodat we elkaar leren kennen en zo weten hoe we het beste uit elkaar kunnen halen. We gaan scrummend de werkweek door met een dagelijkse stand\-up, een tweewekelijkse review en retrospective. En daar houdt ons samenwerken niet op. We werken hybride maar zijn één dag in de week te vinden op kantoor. Omdat de meeste van onze directe collega’s op kantoor in Rotterdam zijn te vinden zal dat hoofdzakelijk daar zijn maar het kan ook voorkomen dat we een keer werken op onze vestiging in Amsterdam of Den Haag. We weten elkaar continu te vinden voor het delen van kennis en vragen. Je kunt echt op je collega’s rekenen.

  

  

Bij NN werken we hybride. Deels vanuit huis en deels op kantoor. Teams ontmoeten elkaar digitaal, fysiek of hybride. Je spreekt samen met je team af wat het beste past. We hebben onze kantoren zo ingericht dat er voor elk type werk een passende plek is. De officiële standplaats van deze functie is Rotterdam. Als Data engineer werk je in dat geval direct naast Rotterdam Centraal, boven het Nationale\-Nederlanden DE Café. In ons restaurant eet je een gezonde lunch en bieden we je ook een uitgebreide Aziatische keuken.

  

  

**Heb je vragen?**

Heb je nog vragen over de vacature of de procedure? Stel je vraag aan Rowena Taal, Talent Acquisition Specialist, via rowena.taal@nn\-group.com.Twijfel jij of je wel 100% aan de criteria voldoet? Dan willen we je aanmoedigen om toch te solliciteren. Wij zijn benieuwd naar jouw unieke kwaliteiten!



Stel je vraag aan Rowena Taal
**Bij** **NN** **geloven we dat onze verschillen ons sterker maken.**


We verwelkomen talent in alle vormen en waarderen de unieke ervaringen, achtergronden, perspectieven en kwaliteiten die iedereen meebrengt. Daarom bouwen we aan een inclusieve werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich welkom, gewaardeerd en vrij voelt om zichzelf te zijn.


Twijfel je of je aan alle functie\-eisen voldoet? Laat dat je niet tegenhouden om te solliciteren. We zijn niet alleen geïnteresseerd in je ervaring, maar ook in je motivatie, je potentieel en de impact die je wilt maken.


**Be yourself. You belong at NN.**


**Ben je net zo enthousiast?**
------------------------------


Je wordt doorgestuurd naar NN's recruitment systeem, Workday, waar je kunt solliciteren en jouw sollicitatie kunt beheren.

As MES/MOM engineer at GKN Aerospace in Papendrecht, The Netherlands, you will be involved in the Development, Implementation, Validation and Support of our Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solution based on Siemens Opcenter Execution, deployed at sites in the APAC, EU and NA regions.

------------------------


* Support and maintain current MES deployments in multiple Production sites.
* Package and deploy new GKN customization releases to Test and Production environments.
* Install/upgrade and configure Opcenter for new implementations and deployments.
* Set up and maintain integrations with surrounding applications using Opcenter Connect MOM.
* Understand business processes and functional requirements and convert into technical specifications.
* Translate functional and design specifications into MES objects: workflows, equipment classes, etc.
* Develop custom logic when justified by a valid business case and no out of the box solution is available.
* Define test specifications, participate in tests and validation.
* Develop tools and templates to speed up the design process, make the support process more efficient and increase application stability and usability.
* Conduct technical training when required to share development best practices.
**Job Qualifications**
----------------------


To help us make a difference, you’ll bring your passion and talent for what you do along with the following skills, experience, qualifications and attributes:

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of working experience in a similar role.
* Extensive experience in Windows server administration, application management and configuration including IIS, certificates, services, firewall, Powershell.
* Experience with Kubernetes and managing applications running as Docker Containers an
* Extensive experience in Oracle/MS SQL database management and query methods.

* Experience in supporting and troubleshooting applications, ideally in the field of manufacturing or production.
* Experience in supporting the implementation of software solutions and participating in IT projects.
* Strong commitment and responsibility to maintain and support production environments.
* Eagerness to expand current knowledge and learn new skills.
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills, Dutch would be a plus.
* Ability to work in multi\-cultural environments, team player.
* Willingness to travel.

We are committed to offer you fantastic challenges and amazing opportunities, a career that can go in many directions thanks to our breadth of international opportunities. By being part of GKN Fokker Aerospace that has proven itself to be at the cutting edge of our industry, you will know that you will be working towards being the most trusted partner in the aerospace industry.
  

In the role of MES\\MOM Systems Developer/Engineer you will belong to an international team of experts. We will not only provide you with the conditions to perform at the best of your capabilities, but we will also support and promote your professional and personal development. Furthermore, we will offer you:  

  



* A gross monthly salary in scale K for a medior at € 3\.952 up to € 5\.715,\- depending on your work experience,
* 8% holiday allowance,
* 40 paid holidays for full\-time employment in line with the Collective Labor Agreement Metalektro (27 holidays and 13 ADV days),
* An excellent pension scheme (PME) and travel allowance,
* Hybrid working, giving you the opportunity to balance home and office working,
* Profit sharing scheme,
* A pleasant and informal working environment, in which we work together to achieve the best result for our customers.

We will support your career progression by providing you with learning and development opportunities. jobs.description:
**Be visionary**


Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.


We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

  



**Job Description**

  



Senior Software Engineer \- Flight Data Analysis Software


Uxbridge, West London, 4 days onsite, 1 day from home

  

Every commercial flight records thousands of parameters — control inputs, engine performance, altitude, warnings. When the aircraft lands, that data has to be retrieved, decoded and turned into something an airline's safety team can act on. We build the software that does it. Over 300 airlines use our ground systems, including most of the world's major carriers, alongside military operators. When an airline spots an unstable approach trend before it becomes an incident, our software is usually how they found it.

  

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team in Uxbridge that builds it.

  

What you'll actually do


You'll own features end to end — from design discussion through to release — across a stack that spans a mature .NET backend, Angular front ends, and Python tooling. Specifically:

* Design and build backend services and APIs that process large volumes of flight data, where performance and correctness genuinely matter
* Take technical ownership of a product area: make the architectural calls, and be the person the team asks about it
* Review other engineers' code and mentor two or three developers earlier in their careers
* Work with QA, product and the engineering lead across a normal Agile cycle — planning, standups, reviews, retros
* Help us modernise: we have a long\-lived .NET codebase with some older Windows service components, and part of this role is bringing it forward sensibly rather than rewriting for its own sake


What we need

* Around 4\+ years building production software commercially
* Strong C\#/.NET and solid relational database skills (we use MySQL)
* Comfortable working across the stack — you don't have to be a front\-end specialist, but you should be able to work in TypeScript/Angular when a feature needs it
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs
* Genuinely good at debugging: the ability to work out why a system is misbehaving from incomplete information
* Git and modern version control workflows


Useful, but we'll teach you

* Python
* AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS)
* Docker and CI/CD pipelines
* Automated testing frameworks
* Aviation or aerospace domain knowledge — almost nobody arrives with this, and we don't expect you to

  

You do not need to tick every box. If you're strong on the backend and curious about the rest, apply.

  

What we offer

*As part of the wider Teledyne UK group, we offer our employees a range of company benefits that include:*

* + Salary sacrifice\-led pension plan that matches employee contributions up to 7%.
	+ Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
	+ Free life assurance cover at the value of four times basic annual salary.
	+ ⁠Salary sacrifice Electric \& Hybrid Vehicle car scheme
	+ 25 days holiday per annum, plus bank holidays.
	+ Holiday purchase scheme which enables employees to purchase an additional 5 days worth of annual leave each year.
	+ Company funded medical cash plan (MediCash) which allows eligible members to offset the cost of routine medical treatments.
	+ Internal reward and recognition scheme linked to internal benefits platform.
	+ Employee Assistance Programme.
	+ Comprehensive wellbeing programme that supports employees with their physical, mental and financial health, as well as their cultural/environmental wellbeing.
	+ Competitive employee discounts platform that provides employees with discounts with leading brands/retailers.
	+ Cycle to Work scheme.
	+ Enhanced family\-friendly benefits and policies.
	+ Company sick pay.
	+ Free Onsite parking
	+ Career development across the wider Teledyne group — a lot of our engineers have moved between teams, sites and disciplines
	+ Software that matters: what you ship affects how safely aircraft are operated

  

The commute, honestly


We're onsite four days a week with one day from home. We know that rules us out for some people. But if you live anywhere in West London, Hillingdon, Buckinghamshire or along the M4/M40, this is likely the shortest commute you'll find for a role at this level — Uxbridge is the end of the Metropolitan and Piccadilly lines, and there's parking. Several of our team took this job specifically to stop commuting into central London.

  

Interview process

* A Teams call with the hiring manager and site manager — informal, both ways
* An onsite session covering technical discussion and a paired programming task, plus competency\-based questions with our Head of Digital Solutions
* Offer

  

About Teledyne Controls


Since 1964 we've designed and manufactured aircraft data recording and management systems, working directly with airlines and with OEMs including Airbus and Boeing. Teledyne Controls Flight Data Company in Uxbridge is our principal UK office, where we develop the ground\-based software used to replay and analyse recorded flight data.

  



Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Job Introduction
**Background:**


Agilio Software Group is a leading UK healthcare operations software provider, delivering integrated, mission critical solutions that support primary care, dental, pharmacy, hospital, and veterinary organisations. We have ambitious and exciting growth plans and are looking for talented individuals to be part of our journey. iLearn is our learning and compliance platform, supporting healthcare organisations to meet regulatory requirements, maintain workforce competence, and deliver high quality patient care.

**The Role:**


We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to join Agilio and take ownership of several of our engineering teams and products.  

The exact shape of the role will evolve, but you’ll likely be working across 3–4 engineering teams and around 6 products. It’s a broad role, so you’ll need to be comfortable balancing priorities across different teams and products and knowing where to focus your time.  

  

Agilio has grown significantly over the last seven years, bringing together around 20 businesses through acquisition. As a result, we have a large and varied portfolio of healthcare software, with products at different stages of maturity, built using different technologies and architectures.  

  

We’re investing in modernising and consolidating our technology, improving how we build and operate software, and exploring how AI can change the way our engineering teams work. This creates some interesting engineering challenges and plenty of opportunity to influence what the next stage of Agilio’s technology looks like.

**Key Responsibilities:**


You’ll be responsible for the people, delivery and engineering health of your teams and products.  

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product and stakeholders across the business to agree priorities, solve problems and make the right decisions about where we invest our engineering time.

* Lead, coach and develop engineers across your teams.  

Support Lead Engineers and other technical leaders to take ownership and lead effectively.
* Work closely with Product to shape priorities, plans and the longer\-term direction of your products.
* Build strong relationships across the business and represent Engineering in decisions affecting your products.
* Own the technical direction and architecture across your products, working with Lead Engineers and teams to make good technical decisions and ensure they align with our wider technology direction.
* Understand the technical health of your products, including security, reliability, performance, maintainability and technical debt.
* Make sure technical risks and investment needs are understood and factored into plans alongside product and customer priorities.
* Help teams create realistic delivery plans, manage dependencies and identify risks early.
* Help remove blockers and make decisions and trade\-offs when teams need support.
* Improve engineering practices across areas such as automated testing, CI/CD, observability, security and operating software in production.
* Help teams make practical use of AI across the software development lifecycle and share what works across Engineering.
* Work with other Engineering Managers and technical leaders to solve common problems, align technical approaches and reduce unnecessary duplication across products.
* Recruit and onboard engineers as the teams grow.


Contribute to engineering initiatives that span teams and products.  

  

You’ll need to be comfortable with technology. You won’t make every technical decision, but you’ll be accountable for the technical direction of your area. You’ll need to understand the important decisions, challenge where necessary and make sure, we’re making choices that work beyond an individual team or product.  

  

You’ll also need to know when to step back and trust the engineers closest to the problem

**Our technology**


Our technology reflects the range of products that have come together as Agilio has grown.  

Most of our software is .NET, alongside products built using PHP and Python. Our products are predominantly web\-based, with a mixture of server\-side rendered applications and SPAs, alongside a smaller number of mobile applications built using Flutter.  

Today our products run across Microsoft Azure, AWS and Google Cloud, with Azure as our strategic cloud platform going forward.  

Part of the opportunity is helping us evolve this estate — making sensible decisions about where we standardise and consolidate while continuing to support and improve the products our customers rely on today.

**Essential**

* Proven experience leading and developing multiple software engineering teams.
* Previous experience in an Engineering Manager, Software Development Manager, Head of Engineering, or similar leadership role.
* Experience working closely with Product teams and business stakeholders to prioritise work and balance competing demands.
* Strong understanding of modern software development practices, including Agile delivery methodologies.
* Experience overseeing the technical direction of products and making decisions relating to architecture, security, scalability, reliability and technical debt.
* Ability to identify, assess and manage technical and delivery risks.
* Experience coaching, mentoring and developing engineers and technical leaders.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of an organisation.
* Experience managing products or platforms across a varied technology estate.
* Good understanding of cloud\-based software environments (Azure, AWS or GCP).Experience improving engineering practices such as CI/CD, automated testing, observability and secure software development.Ability to make pragmatic decisions and trade\-offs in complex technical environments.
* Right to work in the UK.

**Additional Information**

**Job type:** The role is remote with occasional travel to one of our offices on an ad\-hoc basis.  

**Salary:** Competitive \+ generous benefits


Income Protection  

Life Assurance  

Enhanced pension  

Health Cash plan  

28 days annual leave \+ bank holidays  

Sick pay scheme  

A range of flexible benefits available through our Agilio Flex portal  

  

If you feel you have what it takes to join our team, we look forward to receiving your application!


Please note: Due to the volume of applications received, we may not be able to contact every applicant individually. We appreciate your interest in Agilio Software Group and thank you for taking the time to apply.

jobs.title: Plumbing and Heating Engineer
jobs.description:
##### **About Aira**


Clean\-energy tech leads to a positive global transformation. Heating homes contribute to 15% of Europe's CO2 emissions. Switching to sustainable solutions offers households a way to achieve net\-zero emissions.


Aira's mission is to advance the next generation of home energy solutions, creating intelligent, sustainable homes for a meaningful impact. Starting with innovative heat pumps, it will evolve into a comprehensive, intelligent clean energy\-tech system and include dynamic electrical tariffs, cutting\-edge home solar systems, and advanced battery storage solutions.

##### **Upgrade Your Career With Aira**


Are you looking for a career, rather than a job? Are you looking for a place where you can take pride in your work, whilst installing the latest technology? That's Aira.


We're looking for plumbers and heating engineers to join our team of Clean Energy Technicians.

  

If you're currently fitting radiators, heating systems, or cylinders, we want to hear from you. **You do not need previous heat pump experience to apply!**


You'll be working with an experienced, qualified heat pump installer and ensuring that high quality heat pump installations are carried out safely and efficiently.

##### **What you'll be doing**

* You'll be helping families lower their costs and carbon footprint by working in a team to install the very latest Aira heat pumps, cylinders, and radiators.
* You'll work closely with your team, as well as our designers to make sure that you'll only be fitting efficient, reliable systems. All your jobs will have been properly surveyed, and you'll be given schematic diagrams for every installation.
* You'll train at the Aira Academy to become the best Plumbing and Heating Engineer you can be, with progression to becoming a Heat Pump Installer. You will have the opportunity for development and professional growth with the UK's fastest growing Heat Pump installer.
* You'll be Joining a Europe\-Wide team of Engineers as part of the Aira family.

##### **What we would like you to have**


We will provide all necessary Air Source Heat Pump training at our own Aira Academy's throughout the UK, however we need you to have the following:

* NVQ level 2 plumbing (or equivalent)
* Experience installing radiators, cylinders, and pipework


Any of the following would be good to have:

* NVQ Level 3 plumbing (or equivalent)
* WRAS Qualifications (water regs)
* Unvented hot water systems (part G)
* Gas qualifications

##### **What we offer**

* Base Salary of £36,050 \+ overtime and bonus
* 25 days Annual Leave plus Bank Holidays
* Health Cash Plan
* Reward Gateway (Shopping Discount)
* Life Insurance
* Pension
* Referral Scheme
* Aira Academy Access for Personal Professional Development
* Van, All tools, uniform, and equipment provided
* Company phone

*(We encourage early applications as we may close the role once we find the right candidate.)*


At Aira, We’re not just champions of next\-generation energy, we’re champions in Diversity and Inclusion too. We believe that a diverse workforce sparks innovation and creativity and enables us to better serve our customers and communities. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives to join our team. We will never accept any form of discrimination and believe that together, we can drive a new era for our people and planet.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Answer Digital is looking to recruit a Principal Software Engineer to play a pivotal role in shaping how we deliver our large\-scale, operationally critical projects.


This is a senior leadership opportunity for someone who wants to help set the direction for software engineering at Answer: co\-owning capability strategy, raising the technical bar across our teams, and acting as a trusted voice with our biggest clients.

**What you'll be doing**

* As a key member of the senior Engineering Leadership team, you will help shape the strategy, standards and growth of our largest capability.
* Owning the technical direction across multiple client engagements, ensuring the solutions we propose are sound, deliverable and aligned with each client's wider business and technical strategy.
* Setting and upholding the engineering standards our teams work to, including code quality, security, assurance and operability, and being accountable for the technical quality of what your engagements deliver.
* Leading the technical side of new business: shaping proposals, owning the technical content of bids and pitches, and being a credible senior voice in front of prospective clients.
* Driving continuous improvement of our software development practices, tooling and technology choices across the capability
* Building trusted relationships with client stakeholders at executive and director level, and acting as the senior technical escalation point across your engagements.
* Shaping how Answer adopts AI\-assisted engineering, including the standards and guardrails for its use across our teams and how we offer it to clients.
* Mentoring and developing senior engineers and technical leads, and building a strong pipeline of technical leadership within Answer
* Representing Engineering in cross\-capability and company\-wide leadership discussions
* Representing Answer externally: speaking at and attending events such as Leeds Digital Festival, contributing to the wider engineering community, and helping build Answer's reputation as a place where serious engineering happens

**What you'll bring to Answer**

* A strong track record of technical leadership at scale, ideally across multiple teams or projects simultaneously
* Experience providing technical leadership to clients as well as internal teams, including at executive and director level
* Hands\-on experience delivering large\-scale, complex development projects, ideally in a consultancy or software vendor setting
* Agile delivery experience with continuous delivery, and a strong grasp of secure, operable software: threat modelling, assurance evidence, observability and cloud cost
* Practical experience adopting AI\-assisted engineering tooling within teams, and a clear view on where it helps, where it doesn't, and how to govern its use
* Deep expertise in .NET, ASP.NET Core and C\#
* Strong SQL and NoSQL database experience
* AWS/Azure experience
* JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks
* The ability to shape our engineering practice, standards and strategy, not just deliver within it

**It would be great if you also had experience in some of these, but if not we'll help you with them**

* Delivering software in regulated environments, particularly health and the NHS, including clinical safety, data protection and public sector assurance requirements
* Technical involvement in bids, tenders and pre\-sales
* Defining technical solutions involving integration with legacy systems, interoperability and system\-to\-system integration
* Common design patterns such as event\-based architecture, CQRS and Domain\-Driven Design
* Experience contributing to or owning a capability\-level strategy (technology roadmaps, standards, hiring strategy)
* Public speaking, writing or open source contribution in your technical area

**The perks of being at Answer**


We’re an Employee\-Owned Company. After 12 months – through the Employee Ownership Trust you will be part of the ownership of Answer; a major factor in driving engagement, retention and growth for our people


* Competitive salary
* Flexible annual leave (buy/sell and carry forward)
* Twice a year income\-tax free bonus based on company performance \- it’s a reward for being a part of our EOT journey
* Continuous training and development \- if you want to learn, we’ll provide the support you need

Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's cutting\-edge learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.

Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

----------------------------

* Experience with distributed, multi\-tiered systems, algorithms, and relational databases
* Experience with Cloud platforms (preferably AWS), database systems (SQL and NoSQL), AI tools for development productivity, contributing to open\-source projects, and/or version control systems
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
* Ability to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions
* Adept at handling ambiguous or undefined problems as well as ability to think abstractly
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

**Job Title:** R\&D Member of Technical Staff II, Core AI Services

**Location:** Cambridge, United Kingdom (Hybrid)

**Employment Type:** full\-time

 **The job**


We are looking for a passionate Software Engineer to join our Core AI Services team. In this role, you will help design, develop, and scale AI\-enabling platform services and public APIs that are secure, reliable, and cloud\-native. These services will act as foundational building blocks for AI adoption across AVEVA’s product portfolio and partner ecosystem.

  

If you are a motivated engineer who is energized by the challenge of building scalable platform services and clean APIs for modern AI workloads, we want to talk to you.

  

Working at the forefront of agentic systems and harness engineering, you will join an agile Scrum team with a true builder mindset—delivering innovative, secure, and production\-grade AI capabilities with the agility of a startup. This role is ideal for an engineer with a genuine passion for keeping up with the latest AI engineering patterns and practices, eager to translate emerging tech into reliable, enterprise\-ready software.

 **Key responsibilities**

* Build scalable, fault\-tolerant cloud\-native services on Microsoft Azure, ensuring high performance and reliability.
* Develop and refine secure, well\-documented public APIs and SDKs for consumption by internal and external developers using ASP.NET Core and C\#.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver end\-to\-end solutions across data pipelines, orchestration, and service APIs.
* Embed robust security controls to protect sensitive data and ensure secure access to AI services.
* Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and implementation discussions to ensure engineering excellence.

 **Essential requirements**

* Minimum of 2 years professional experience in software engineering, preferably in platform or cloud\-native service development, Microsoft and .NET technologies a plus.
* Solid understanding of RESTful API design, versioning, testing, and lifecycle management.
* Proficient in securing APIs, managing authentication/authorization and data privacy practices.
* Practical experience deploying and debugging scalable cloud\-native services using PaaS, Docker, and Kubernetes.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills, with the ability to analyse complex technical challenges and propose scalable solutions.

 **Desired skills and competencies**

* Interest or exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), agent orchestration, prompt engineering, and tool calling.
* Familiarity with AI standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A).
* Experience with tools for automated testing and evaluation of AI outputs
* Experience working in Agile teams and collaborating across global R\&D locations

**Application process**

  

* Online strengths\-based assessment
* Application form
  

CVs and cover letters are not required as part of the application process. Candidates will be assessed through a single\-stage strengths\-based interview.

  

Start your career with a global, employee\-owned consultancy where your work can make a real difference. At Mott MacDonald, you'll work alongside experts, contribute to meaningful projects, and have the support, learning opportunities, and experience needed to grow your career from day one.

  

**Job Description**

  

Graduate Software Engineer \- Glasgow (Need to be elligible for security clearance)


The Digital Solutions team within the Mott MacDonald Digital, Technology \& Services portfolio develops and supports a diverse range of bespoke and product\-based software systems for clients across the UK, internationally and within the Mott MacDonald group. These systems are developed by our in\-house software engineering team, utilising a wide range of programming technologies, deployed into varying technology stacks. We provide a dynamic, project\-orientated development environment, with teams involved in the full lifecycle of system delivery from requirements definition through to design, development, platform configuration, and ultimately live system support.


Our primary domain is in the Transport sector, solving real\-world problems for clients that manage transport networks and own all forms of transport assets – digital, data, and infrastructure. We also provide technical input across multiple domains for projects across Mott MacDonald meaning we play our part in maintaining Mott MacDonald’s carbon neutral certification.

  

**Candidate Specification**

  

At Mott MacDonald, we’re looking for curious, motivated graduates who want to make a real difference. Join our purpose\-driven teams where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work enhances the world we live in.


To be eligible for this opportunity, you will have less than 12 months’ relevant experience (excluding placements) and have a minimum of a bachelor’s degree (obtained no earlier than 2025\) or expected to achieve one in one of the following degree disciplines (that have a significant Java, C\#, and/or Python content):


* Computer science
* Software engineering
* Other software related disciplines
Some of these opportunities will require you to be eligible to achieve security clearance. Security clearance is dictated by the types of projects we work on and normally requires you to be a UK British national or lived in the UK for five years or more.

  

In your application, you should aim to demonstrate your genuine interest in both the opportunity and in joining Mott MacDonald. You can do this by highlighting any relevant experience or interests \- such as modules you've studied, previous work experience, or any research you've undertaken about our company, values, and projects.


We personally review every completed application form we receive as this part of our selection process is entirely human led – we do not use AI tools at this stage and kindly ask you not to either. We want you to answer each application question with authenticity so we can get to know the real you. Joining us as a graduate is your opportunity to shape your own story.

  

We are looking for graduates with the following strengths:


* Proactively takes initiative to complete tasks efficiently and independently.
* Communicates effectively and clearly with clients and colleagues.
* Delivers high quality written work with strong attention to detail and clarity.
* Demonstrates a structured and analytical approach to problem solving.
  

**UK Immigration**


Mott MacDonald Ltd. are not currently offering sponsorship to candidates under the Skilled Worker visa route in the UK. This decision is as a consequence of the changes made to the Skilled Worker route by the UK Government in April 2024\.


Our ethos is to develop, train and retain our graduates and therefore we are looking for a long\-term relationship with our graduates. For this reason, we cannot accept applications from candidates who would be working under the Graduate visa route or other time\-limited visas, (irrespective of visa duration), due to their temporary nature and the requirement for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route in future.


We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future.

  

**AI Usage**


At Mott MacDonald, we see the value AI can bring, but we take a people\-first approach to hiring. While AI tools can help candidates prepare and build confidence, every application and hiring decision is reviewed by our recruitment and hiring teams. We encourage the responsible use of AI while ensuring we get to know the real person behind the application.

  

**Accessibility**

We want you to feel supported and able to perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. If there is anything we can do to make applying or interviewing with us more accessible, please contact us at **reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com** and we'll be happy to discuss how we can help.

  

**About your development**


A graduate position should be more than just a job. We know this and so do you. That’s why with our graduate roles we aim to give you the experience and technical knowledge you need to progress your career. From the moment you join us, you’ll receive the training you need. You will be assigned a mentor, who will guide you to meet the objectives of your professional training needs. You will join our three\-year early careers soft skills development programme – Accelerating your Future, which is designed to give you the skills and tools necessary for a long\-lasting successful career here at Mott MacDonald.

  

**Our social side**

  

  

Being part of Mott MacDonald means more than just work; there’s a huge range of fun and exciting things that you can get involved in.


From the moment you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your social and professional network, whether it’s meeting other graduates or joining forces with other members of staff from around the company at our annual sports day. Each of our offices have a sports and social committee which will give you the chance to be part of a variety of sports, social and charity events. We’re committed to promoting a strong culture of social responsibility and encourage our staff to play active roles in the local community.


It's worth noting that sports and social committees tend to vary from office to office, so as well as getting involved in what’s already on offer, don’t be afraid to suggest new events or initiatives that you think could be a great addition. It doesn’t stop there. From your first day, you’ll have access to Perks at Work, giving you discounts on cinema tickets, travel, utilities and much more, helping you make the most of our employee benefits.

  

**Agile working**

At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well\-being, flexibility, and trust.

  

**Equality, diversity, and inclusion**


We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where **everyone** feels they can contribute.

  

**We offer some fantastic benefits including:**

  

**Financial wellbeing**


* **Biannual salary reviews:** We believe hard work should be recognised and rewarded. To support your development and progression, you'll be eligible for salary reviews twice a year during your first three years with us, subject to successfully completing your probation period.
* We match employee pension contributions between 4\.5% and 7%.
* Life assurance equal up to 4 x your basic salary, with an option to increase the level of cover to 6 x your salary.
* Our income protection scheme provides a financial benefit, as well as absence and return to work support due to long\-term illness or injury.
* Flexible benefits, including increased life assurance cover, critical illness insurance, payroll saving and will writing.
* As an independently owned business we share the financial success of the business with all our colleagues in various ways including annual bonus schemes.
  

**Employee Ownership**


* Our employee ownership model means no external investors, just us, creating a culture of shared success.
* Our employees have a stake and a voice in our business, giving them a direct connection to our success through our personal and group performance bonuses.
* As your career grows, so does your stake, recognising your long\-term impact and contribution.
* Your voice matters, with the opportunity to connect directly with senior leadership through formal channels to help shape our future.
* For our senior roles you will have a direct pathway towards ownership from day one.
  

**Health and wellbeing**


* Private medical insurance for all UK colleagues.
* Health cash plan to support you with every day health costs and treatments.
* Access to Peppy, providing free support from menopause experts for all UK colleagues.
* A variety of wellbeing support is available through our comprehensive wellbeing program, including access for you and your family.
* Ability to flex your salary to opt into a wide range of health benefits, many of which can be extended to your family too.
  

**Lifestyle**

* 33 days holiday each year, inclusive of public holidays and dependent on level, with the ability to buy or sell leave through our flexible benefits programme.
* 10 days additional paid leave for Armed Forces Reservists and Cadet Force Adult Volunteers.
* Holiday entitlement increased to a minimum of 35 days after 5 years’ service.
* Variety of employee saving schemes and discounts from high\-street retailers.
  

**Enhanced family and carers leave**


* Enhanced family leave policies, including 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave, and two weeks paid paternity/partner leave.
* Our shared parental leave matches maternity leave meaning we pay up to 24 weeks at full pay.
* Up to five additional days leave are provided for those with significant caring responsibilities, two of which are paid.
* We offer policies and dedicated support to help military families balance service life with career and wellbeing.
  

**Learning and development**


* Primary annual professional institution subscription.
* A broad range of opportunities to enhance both technical and soft skills through mentoring, formal training, and self\-development options.
  

**Networks, communities, and social outcomes**


* Join a wide range of groups including our Advanced Employee Networks which support our LGBTQ\+, gender, race and ethnicity, disability, and parents/carers communities.
* We are proud signatories of the Armed Forces Covenant and Gold Award holders in the MOD Employer Recognition Scheme, supported by our dedicated internal Armed Forces Network.

### **About The Role**



**Why choose us?**

  


**BRUSH Group** **provides the energy solutions that help power our built world****.** From power transformers to switchgear and engineering solutions, for generations, the **BRUSH** brand has stood for engineering excellence.



We are committed to supporting the global effort for industrial decarbonisation and sustainable development and have set ambitious objectives to achieve our target of net zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050\.

Eta Projects Ltd. provide Authorising Services to a range of clients across the United Kingdom and Ireland. The role purpose is to monitor and audit SSoW predominately within and Healthcare environment, reporting on compliance with Statutory and Company procedures. The role will be remote based from home but will require travel to client sites. The role involves;  

  

* Providing timely and accurate input to incident investigations and resolving technical operational issues.
* Audit, process and findings of the Technical Compliance Audits – assist with the closure of the non\-conformances.
* Managing and offering guidance of Electrical Equipment Safety Alerts.
* Issuing audit findings via a technical audit report to Designated Person/Principal Engineer agreeing a suitable site AP Action Plan.
* Maintaining a register of all Authorised Persons including their training records and areas of responsibility.
* To act as Technical Lead offering advice and guidance on a range of complex electrical projects and systems.

* Undertaking technical compliance audits, reporting on areas of non\-compliance.
* Identify, develop, assess and recommend for appointment suitable candidates for Appointment as Authorised Person.
* Assessing the experience, training and competence of Authorised Persons; providing recommendations of appointment.
* Providing technical and engineering support to ensure all Authorised Persons are competent to carry out their function to ensure compliance and succession planning.

jobs.title: Software Tester (Unit Test/AtlassianToolchain) - Contractor
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Software Tester to join a multi\-disciplinary engineering team delivering safety\- and mission\-critical software for the maritime defence sector. You will be embedded with the various development teams, working at the code level as well as the system level, and taking ownership of the unit and integration test estate across both Windows and Linux targets.



This is a first hand role for a tester who is comfortable in the codebase. As well as designing and executing tests, you will strengthen the test tooling, keep automated test execution running reliably in the CI pipeline, and ensure that test evidence is traceable from requirement through to result within the Atlassian toolchain.



The successful candidate will work on site at our Rugeley, Staffordshire facility, alongside software engineers, systems engineers, and quality assurance colleagues.

  


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Design, write, review, and maintain unit tests for new and legacy code, working to agreed coverage and quality targets.
* Develop and maintain integration and regression test suites that execute automatically on both Windows and Linux build agents.
* Analyse requirements and design documentation to derive test cases and maintain bidirectional traceability from requirement to test case to result.
* Own the test management workflow in Jira — including test issue types, workflows, boards, and reporting — and keep test artefacts current in Confluence.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines, Bamboo or Jenkins), diagnose pipeline failures, and keep the build green.
* Investigate, reproduce, and clearly document defects; triage them with developers and track them to closure.
* Produce test plans, test specifications, test reports, and evidence packs suitable for internal review and customer acceptance.
* Measure and report on code coverage, test pass rates, and defect trends, and recommend improvements where quality risk is emerging.
* Support code reviews with a testability and quality perspective and coach developers on effective unit testing practice.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of test strategy, tooling, and process across the programme.
* Work within the organisation’s configuration management, information security, and quality management procedures always.

  


**Essential Skills and Experience:**


**Testing**


* Demonstrable commercial experience as a software tester, test engineer, or SDET on a software development team.
* Strong practical experience of unit testing and test\-driven development, using frameworks such as Google Test, Catch2, CppUnit, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, JUnit or pytest.
* Ability to read, write and debug code in at least one of C\+\+, C\#, Java, or Python to write meaningful tests and reproduce defects.
* Experience with mocking and test\-double frameworks (for example Google Mock, Moq, Mockito, unittest.mock).
* Working knowledge of code coverage and static analysis tooling (for example gcov/lcov, OpenCover, SonarQube, Coverity, Polyspace).
* Experience designing test cases from written requirements and maintaining requirements\-to\-test traceability.
* Sound defect management practice — clear reproduction steps, severity assessment, evidence capture and closure verification.


**Atlassian suite**


* Firsthand experience with Jira, including creating and configuring boards, workflows, issue types, filters, and dashboards.
* Experience with a Jira test management application such as Xray, Zephyr Scale or TestRail integration.
* Confluence authoring — test plans, test specifications, procedures, and structured technical documentation.
* Bitbucket for source control, branching strategy, pull requests and code review.
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting automated builds and test stages in Bamboo, Bitbucket Pipelines.


**Platforms and tooling**


* Confident working across both Windows and Linux — command line, scripting, filesystem, permissions, and services on each.
* Scripting for test automation and environment setup (PowerShell, Bash, and/or Python).
* Familiarity with cross\-platform build systems and toolchains (CMake, MSBuild, make, GCC/Clang, MSVC).
* Comfortable setting up and maintaining test environments, including virtual machines and containers.
* Git fluency — branching, merging, rebasing, and resolving conflicts.


**Desirable Skills:**


* Prior experience in defence, maritime, aerospace, nuclear, rail or another safety\- or security\-critical regulated domain.
* Awareness of relevant standards and practice such as DO\-178C, IEC 61508, MISRA C/C\+\+, or Def Stan 00\-055/00\-056\.
* ISTQB Foundation (or higher) certification, or equivalent formal test qualification.
* Experience testing embedded, real\-time, sensor or signal\-processing software.
* Experience of hardware\-in\-the\-loop or rig\-based testing, and of testing against simulated data sets.
* Exposure to test automation at system level (for example Robot Framework, Squish, Selenium, or bespoke harnesses).
* Experience of formal verification and validation activities and customer witness testing.
* Familiarity with Atlassian administration, including permission schemes and app configuration.

  


**Note: All candidates must meet the security vetting requirements relevant to the role. For reasons of national security, applicants must be British nationals. Dual nationals may be permitted in exceptional circumstances.**
